recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-7911; reverting the element name to supportingInformation would conflict with the later published FHIR-11185 rename and current migration metadata.
issue_request: FHIR-7911 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Pharmacy change request asking for a MedicationStatement attribute that links to underlying prescription, administration, dispense, claim, observation, or questionnaire-style records so systems can tell whether a statement is patient-reported or derived from another clinical record.
initial_application: Git commit 30268c3a5ac73f9b6472e930cdb9d11ee5c4c710, matching the Jira comment svn 6623, added MedicationStatement.supportingInformation to the then-authoritative MedicationStatement spreadsheet as 0..* Reference(Any) with the requested likely-reference comment.
additional_context: Later Published Pharmacy issue FHIR-11185 renamed MedicationStatement.supportingInformation to MedicationStatement.derivedFrom and kept it as the Reference(Any)-style derivation link. Current source/fhir.ini still maps MedicationStatement.supportingInformation to MedicationStatement.derivedFrom, and FHIR-12536 plus current narrative text explain that MedicationStatement can be derived from supporting information such as Claim, Observation, or MedicationRequest.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active MedicationStatement StructureDefinition already has MedicationStatement.derivedFrom at 0..* Reference(Resource), which is the current representation of the same Any-resource link, with definition/comment text covering MedicationRequest, MedicationDispense, Claim, Observation, QuestionnaireResponse, and other supporting derivation resources.
